checks.retelling: Different P/D workload sizes motivate different parallel groups. Wider EP gathers more input rows per expert weight copy, reducing repeated ideal reads only at useful concurrency. Replicas trade memory and reads for hotspot relief. Ready input and output blocks allow compute/return overlap without bypassing dependencies. Shared KV reduces recomputation and frees routing; P time quotas and D request/KV load distribute remaining work. The measured service-speed/throughput curve, full fees and effective output constrain the cost conclusion; educational counts are not speed multipliers.
